verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not an automation or workflow software product, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for it. Its mentions of internal legal tech and the software-supported YSolutions service describe how the firm delivers its own work. They do not show user-facing automations that a customer could version or roll back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
